notes.title: We’re back! Development is moving forward — Thank you for your support!
notes.content:
Thank you so much for playing the playtest!

We’re really sorry for the slow progress so far.  
The truth is, the developer lacked confidence and kept extending the project over and over…

But! Finally!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42353123/ab9aceae1778aae559ec0188e7a89916816bec86.png[/img]
Development has picked up speed, and the core systems are now in place.  
We’re now aiming for a full release within a year—and we’ll do our very best to make it happen!

We hope you’ll continue to support us and look forward to  
[b]A little scary but funny adventure of a cute kemo boy (or girl)![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42353123/c6dc3bafd0a95e04edf8fb0a7f652a94d9e58775.png[/img]
